title: D621 MATERIAL-IDENTITY law — every table other than the target set is per-mesh AND per-material identical to main
principle: THE GATE TRUSTS ONLY THE TREE. The BASE is the RECORDED MERGE BASE pinned below (never a moving `main`): the card wrapper archives that commit (`git archive <base.commit> -- web tools`), serves it, captures it, and the verdict carries its commit + tree hash; the HEAD is the audited commit's own archive. After the landing, the merged tree is audited by the merged-tree fences (mesh + material identity per table vs this same base sha), not by re-running this fold against a main that already contains HEAD's entries (CEREMONY-PREP-2 ruling B2).

wasm.rule: the served kernel is PINNED here and verified by the card driver BEFORE the dump (fail-closed, named exit codes). mode 'overlay': the driver serves the overlay directory D621_WASM_OVERLAY (default <private evidence>/diamond/wasm-overlay/pool-wasm — never /tmp) in place of the archive's web/dist/pool-wasm and refuses when pool_wasm_bg.wasm is missing (exit 4, WASM_OVERLAY_MISSING) or its sha256 differs from this pin (exit 5, WASM_PIN_MISMATCH). mode 'archive': the archive's own web/dist/pool-wasm is served and its pool_wasm_bg.wasm sha256 must equal this pin (same exit codes). The ceremony rebakes the canonical wasm on the merged tree and switches THREE fields: mode=archive + rebaked SHA256 + kernel string in ONE tracked edit of this file, which shows in the diff and in the verdict's law_files digests.
